scenes.voiceover: Can an Indian American billionaire become governor of Ohio? The polls say it's anyone's game.
scenes.image_prompt: Hook scene: Ohio governor race toss-up

scenes.voiceover: Cook Political Report just moved Ohio from Lean Republican to Toss Up. Both candidates locked at 47 percent.
Vivek Ramaswamy. Cincinnati native. Harvard and Yale grad. Biotech billionaire. Briefly ran for president in 2024.
His opponent Amy Acton became Ohio's most recognized face during COVID. She's raised a record 18 million dollars.
Ramaswamy self-funded 25 million. A super PAC added another 20 million. But big money hasn't guaranteed wins this cycle.
71 percent of Indian Americans disapprove of the current administration. His H-1B comments didn't help with the community.
Indian Americans now compete at the highest levels of American power. No longer at the margins. Not yet at ease.
